II. רהט (√ of two following; perhaps Aramaic רְהַט = רוּץ run, flow ). II. [ רַ֫הַט ] noun [masculine] dubious, Thes and most lock of hair (? from flowing down); — plural רְהָטִים Cant 7:6.
